English: So, like...I wanna know why the sky's blue.

Because it's actually a huge wall
painted that way. Simple as that.

If you doubt me, why not try flying
up there and seeing for yourself?

Um, but that's probably
way too high even for me...

As it should. No one's found a way
up there to touch it for themself.

Basically. No point in getting
your head in a knot over it.
